paragraphs.text: Yerkoy is a city on the Craggy Coast of southern Jamuraa , on the plane of Dominaria .
Not much is known of this city, but located near the Bay of Shaibara and inhabited by dwarves . Its army uniform is a gold-filigreed green. The city has friendly relations with Bryce .

After the Battle of Bryce , Hazezon Tamar sent out requests for aid from the other cities on the Craggy Coast, as their future fate would be the same: subjugation to the rising Emperor, Johan . Yerkoy responded to Hazezon's call to arms, sending many archers to participate in the Battle of Palmyra .
